name: Sonia Nevermind
original_name: ソニア・ネヴァーマインド
source:
Sonia Nevermind is a foreign exchange student from a small European country called Novoselic. With her porcelain white skin, sparkling blue eyes, and glittering hair, she exudes a mysterious charm that captivates everyone who sees her. Because of her status as a princess, Sonia has never had friends who match her social standing. 
Subsequently, she relishes the opportunity to attend Hope's Peak Academy as a normal teenager to meet people her own age. Though she has a tendency to use slang improperly, her grace and beauty can compel anyone to kneel before without realizing it.
Sonia is also fascinated with serial killers and the occult, and has actually stated that she likes Friday the 13th.
